canonical_statement: For every measurable space alpha and every measure mu on it, the real-valued and complex-valued L2 spaces of measurable functions modulo almost-everywhere equality are complete.
domain_and_universes: universe u; alpha : Type u; MeasurableSpace alpha; mu : Measure alpha; scalar codomains Real and Complex; exponent (2 : ENNReal); Prop in universe 0
conclusion: CompleteSpace (Lp Real 2 mu) and CompleteSpace (Lp Complex 2 mu).
boundary_cases: Zero measure, the empty carrier, and infinite measures are included. Statement.lean checks the zero measure on Empty and counting measure on Nat. No sigma-finiteness or finite-measure hypothesis is imposed.
excluded_cases: the historical Fourier-coefficient realization formulation without a checked source bridge
raw functions without quotienting almost-everywhere equality
Banach-valued Lp as a broadened canonical target
